lcc_original: 瑪土撒拉在世的日子、共有九百六十九年，然後死。
notes: WAH01961 (וַיִּהְיוּ, and-were) mapped to 有 in 共有 — the existential verb; 在世的 is a LCC elaboration with no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
WH03117 (יְמֵי, days-of) was implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC as 日子; braces dropped per rule 3
WAH01961 was also implicit in UNV but 有 is an explicit existential verb in LCC; braces dropped per rule 3
Hebrew has שָׁנָה (WH08141) twice in the number formula — once between hundreds and tens, once at the end — but LCC consolidates to a single 年; both WH08141 tags attach to 年
然後 (then/afterwards) is a LCC connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
